Name: Change willy into Cu
Author: digipaw
Description:
[left][b]UPDATED!!![/b]

[b]NOW WITH Dialouge[/b]!  Please let me know if you see any typos, mistake, lingering mentions of willy, and if anything seems out of character.

A mod that changes Willy into Cu from the fate series, the base of it is now finished, so it is complete with sprites, portraits, and dialogue. I still plan on working on this mod, since I would like to make it so you could marry and date him, but at the moment I do not know how to do that. 


if any of you know how to add events/ make it so you can marry him and what not please let me know, Or if you know how I could make it so I can use images greater than 64x64 for the portraits since id prefer to use ones that I made that where 128x128.

for the time being though, I will probably move on to other mods, some fate related, other not. 

[i]I was inspired by Minrisasoison's mods that add Karna and Arjuna into the game.[/i]

[/b][i][b]How to install visual assets [/b][/i][list]
[*]Download the files 
[*]Open your stardew valleys local files
[*]Go to  Contents--> Characters 
[*]Drag the file named 'Willy.xnb" into your copy of stardew valley 
[*]let it replace the original files 
[*]do the same with the portrait file, but take it to the portrait folder in your copy
[/list][b][i]How to install dialogue + event edits [/i][/b][list]
[*]download the file 
[*]open your stardew vallys local files
[*]go to contents--> characters--> Dialogue 
[*][i]drag in Willy.xnb (not the image ones) [/i]
[*]go to contents --> Data 
[*][i]drag in Mail.xnb, and NPCdispositions.xnb[/i]
[*]go to contents--> data --> Events, 
[*][i]drag in beach.xnb[/i]
[*]go to contents --> Data ---> Festivals 
[*][i]drag in all the festival files in the folder. [/i]
[/list][/left]
